info.title: Vekro Backend
info.description: Escrow and dispute-resolution backend with state-machine driven transaction flows, session-based authentication, and admin dispute tooling.

post.description: Create a buyer or seller account with validated phone and password fields. Registration currently supports only buyer and seller roles.
Authenticate a user, issue server-side session state, and set session + CSRF cookies. Rate limiting and account lockout protections are enforced.

429.description: Too many login attempts or account temporarily locked.

post.description: Revoke the active server-side session when present and clear authentication cookies.

403.description: CSRF token missing, mismatched, or invalid.

get.description: Return the currently authenticated user profile based on active session context.
Liveness endpoint used by operators, CI checks, and uptime monitors.

post.description: Create a listing owned by the authenticated seller. Serialized listings must satisfy unique_id and dispute policy requirements. Add photos afterwards with POST /listings/{listing_id}/photos.

403.description: Authenticated user is not a seller.

get.description: The authenticated seller's own listings, newest first. Filter by status and title; `counts` cover all their listings, before filters.

403.description: Authenticated user is not a seller.

get.description: Public read used by the buyer's Trust Link: content, photos, status and a seller summary, with serialized/dispute policy metadata when present.

patch.description: Change any of the create fields; the result must pass the create rules. Refused (409) once the listing has a paid or pending order, or while it is archived.

403.description: Caller is not the listing's seller.

409.description: The listing can't change in its current status.

post.description: Upload one photo as the raw request body (image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp, at most 2 MB). Photos keep upload order; the first is the cover. At most 4 per listing.

403.description: Caller is not the listing's seller.

409.description: The listing already has the maximum photos.

415.description: Not a JPEG, PNG or WebP.

get.description: Public. Serves the image bytes; photos never change, so they cache for a year.

post.description: The Trust Link stops taking payments. Idempotent. Refused (409) once the listing has a paid or pending order.

403.description: Caller is not the listing's seller.

409.description: The listing can't change in its current status.

post.description: The Trust Link takes payments again. Idempotent.

403.description: Caller is not the listing's seller.

409.description: The listing can't change in its current status.

get.description: Return notifications belonging to the authenticated user only, ordered by newest first. Supports limit/offset pagination for client polling, an unread-only filter and a channel filter (in-app inboxes pass channel=in_app so SMS copies are not repeated).

schema.title: Response List Current User Notifications Notifications Get

post.summary: Mark all my notifications as read

post.description: Idempotent: a notification already read keeps its first read_at.

404.description: Not found, or not the caller's.

get.description: Sample route demonstrating buyer role enforcement.

schema.title: Response Buyer Only Route Protected Buyer Get

403.description: Authenticated user does not have buyer role.

get.description: Sample route demonstrating seller role enforcement.

schema.title: Response Seller Only Route Protected Seller Get

403.description: Authenticated user does not have seller role.

get.description: Sample route demonstrating admin role enforcement.

schema.title: Response Admin Only Route Protected Admin Get

403.description: Authenticated user does not have admin role.

post.description: Create an escrow transaction from a listing as the authenticated buyer. New transactions start in awaiting_payment state. The response carries the payment instruction: an STK prompt sent to the buyer's phone, or a checkout URL to redirect to.

202.description: Transaction created, but payment initiation transport failed (payment.status is failed_to_initiate). Continue with this transaction id and offer a resend.

403.description: Authenticated user is not a buyer.

503.description: Payment initiation failed before a partial-success response could be returned.

get.description: The caller's own orders: orders they bought (buyers) or sold (sellers). Filter by list segment, by status (repeatable) and by reference or listing title; sort and page. `counts` and `status_counts` cover all the caller's orders, before filters.

403.description: Only buyers and sellers have orders.

get.summary: Get one transaction (buyer, seller or admin)
get.description: Read a transaction as its buyer, its seller or an admin: state, listing summary, masked parties and the server deadline for the current state. Clients poll this to learn state changes; anyone else gets 404 so existence is not leaked.

404.description: Transaction not found, or the caller is not a party to it.

get.summary: Get an order's timeline (buyer, seller or admin)
get.description: The order's history, oldest first, in plain words for the caller's role. Built from the caller's own notifications; message bodies and payloads (which can hold the delivery code) are never returned.

schema.title: Response Get Timeline Transactions  Transaction Id  Timeline Get

404.description: Transaction not found, or the caller is not a party to it.

post.description: Send a new STK prompt for an unpaid transaction, for example after the buyer cancelled or missed it. At most one prompt per cooldown (see resend_available_at).

202.description: A prompt was recorded but sending it failed (failed_to_initiate).

403.description: Authenticated user is not a buyer.

404.description: Transaction not found, or the caller is not its buyer.

429.description: Too soon after the last prompt; see the Retry-After header.

post.summary: Confirm payment callback and lock transaction
post.description: Provider callback endpoint that transitions awaiting_payment transactions to locked on successful result_code and safely handles duplicate/non-success callbacks. Requires the X-Payment-Callback-Secret header when PAYMENT_CALLBACK_SECRET is set; without a configured secret it is refused in production. eConfirm transactions are never locked here (their funding is confirmed by polling eConfirm).

parameters.name: X-Payment-Callback-Secret

schema.description: Shared secret; required when PAYMENT_CALLBACK_SECRET is set.
schema.title: X-Payment-Callback-Secret

parameters.description: Shared secret; required when PAYMENT_CALLBACK_SECRET is set.

202.description: Callback acknowledged with no state transition.

401.description: Wrong or missing callback secret, or none configured in production.

post.description: Seller-owned transition from locked to out_for_delivery. Rejects non-owner access and invalid prior states.

403.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to dispatch this transaction.

422.description: Transaction is not eligible for dispatch.

post.description: Seller-owned transition from out_for_delivery to at_door_pending_inspection. Generates a delivery OTP for buyer confirmation.

403.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to mark arrival for this transaction.

422.description: Transaction is not eligible for arrival confirmation.

post.description: Buyer confirmation step for delivery handoff. Transitions to released for non-serialized listings or hold_24h for serialized listings.

403.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to confirm OTP for this transaction.

422.description: Invalid OTP or transaction not in OTP-confirmable state.

post.summary: Withhold delivery OTP and trigger return-refund (buyer only)
post.description: Buyer action that withholds OTP and applies return/refund path transitions from at_door_pending_inspection. An optional body gives the reason and a note for the seller.

403.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to withhold OTP for this transaction.

422.description: Transaction is not eligible for OTP-withhold flow.

post.summary: Report functional issue during hold window (buyer only)
post.description: Buyer dispute-intake endpoint for serialized transactions in hold_24h state. Routes category other directly to admin escalation path.

403.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to report an issue for this transaction.

422.description: Transaction state, listing type, or issue category is invalid.

post.summary: Mark buyer sent-back action in dispute flow (buyer only)
post.description: Buyer transition from disputed_functional to return_in_transit in functional dispute flow.

403.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to update sent-back state.

422.description: Transaction is not eligible for buyer sent-back action.

post.summary: Mark seller received return in dispute flow (seller only)
post.description: Seller transition from return_in_transit to return_received in functional dispute flow.

403.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to update seller-received state.

422.description: Transaction is not eligible for seller-received action.

post.summary: Apply seller dispute resolution action (seller only)
post.description: Seller remediation action endpoint from return_received state. Supports refund_issued, repair_shipped, and replacement_shipped (policy-gated).

403.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to apply resolution action.

422.description: Action is invalid or transaction is not eligible for seller resolution.

post.description: Buyer response to seller remediation outcome from awaiting_buyer_reconfirmation. Reject path retries once before escalated_admin_review.

403.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to submit reconfirmation.

422.description: Transaction is not eligible for buyer reconfirmation.

post.summary: Buyer confirmation for mutual resolution closure
post.description: Buyer-side mutual confirmation update for resolved transactions. Closure requires both buyer and seller confirmations.

403.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to confirm buyer resolution state.

422.description: Transaction is not in a resolved state or validation failed.

post.summary: Seller confirmation for mutual resolution closure
post.description: Seller-side mutual confirmation update for resolved transactions. Closure requires both buyer and seller confirmations.

403.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to confirm seller resolution state.

422.description: Transaction is not in a resolved state or validation failed.

get.summary: List escalated disputes awaiting admin review
get.description: Admin-only queue for disputes currently in escalated_admin_review state, including buyer/seller/listing triage context.

schema.title: Response List Admin Escalation Queue Admin Disputes Escalation Queue Get

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin.

get.summary: Get admin dispute case timeline detail
get.description: Admin-only case view that combines dispute metadata, transaction context, and chronologically ordered timeline events.

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin.

post.summary: Force resolve an escalated dispute case
post.description: Admin-only terminal resolution action for escalated disputes. Applies refund/release/split decision and persists reason/decision metadata.

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin.

409.description: Split payout is not supported by current custody capabilities.

422.description: Dispute state is not eligible or reason/decision is invalid.

get.description: Returns custody mode, provider capability signals, and per-rail circuit breaker state used for routing decisions.

403.description: Authenticated user does not have admin role.

503.description: Custody registry is unavailable in app state.

get.description: Lists audit records for payouts, funding confirmations, and admin money decisions, newest first. Filter by transaction, provider reference, rail, or action.

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin.

post.description: Simulation-only admin control that forces deterministic successful collection in demo environments. Endpoint is disabled in production and is idempotent across retries.

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin or control is disabled in production.

422.description: Payload or escrow reference format is invalid.

post.summary: Progress simulated collection scenario (admin, non-production only)
post.description: Simulation-only admin control that advances deterministic collection status flows (for example out_of_order reconciliation) while preserving idempotent ledger behavior.

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin or control is disabled in production.

404.description: Collection attempt or escrow was not found.

post.summary: Progress simulated payout scenario (admin, non-production only)
post.description: Simulation-only admin control that advances deterministic payout status flows in demo environments. Endpoint is disabled in production and preserves idempotent replay safety.

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin or control is disabled in production.

404.description: Payout attempt or escrow was not found.

422.description: Payout attempt is missing release/refund metadata.

post.description: Accept LOOP collection callbacks, verify signature and timestamp freshness, dedupe by provider reference, and confirm funding through inquiry before trusting callback data.

401.description: Callback signature is missing, invalid, or outside the replay window.

422.description: Callback payload was not valid JSON object content.

get.description: Accept Pesapal callback notifications and always confirm funding finality through server-side transaction status inquiry. Callback payload fields are never trusted as final state by themselves.

post.description: Accept Pesapal callback notifications and always confirm funding finality through server-side transaction status inquiry. Callback payload fields are never trusted as final state by themselves.

AdminCollectionControlResponse.title: AdminCollectionControlResponse

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter currency code for the collection amount.

AdminForceCompleteCollectionRequest.description: Admin simulation control payload for forcing collection success.

decision.description: Terminal decision: refund, release, or split.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Required rationale for the admin decision.

AdminForceResolveRequest.title: AdminForceResolveRequest
AdminForceResolveRequest.description: Admin terminal decision payload for escalated disputes.

AdminForceResolveResponse.title: AdminForceResolveResponse
AdminForceResolveResponse.description: Result returned after an admin force-resolve decision is applied.

AdminPayoutControlResponse.title: AdminPayoutControlResponse
AdminPayoutControlResponse.description: Result payload for payout-focused simulated admin controls.

provider_name.title: Provider Name
provider_name.description: Provider identifier associated with this rail.

breaker_state.description: Current breaker state for the rail.

consecutive_failures.title: Consecutive Failures
consecutive_failures.description: Consecutive failure count tracked for breaker transitions.

opened_at.title: Opened At
opened_at.description: When the breaker most recently moved to OPEN.

last_success_at.title: Last Success At

last_failure_at.title: Last Failure At

cooldown_until.title: Cooldown Until

collection_available.title: Collection Available
collection_available.description: Whether this rail is available for collection routes.

payout_available.title: Payout Available

holds_funds_structurally.title: Holds Funds Structurally

econfirm_needs_reconciliation_count.title: Econfirm Needs Reconciliation Count

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional buyer remarks supporting acceptance or rejection.

BuyerReconfirmationRequest.title: BuyerReconfirmationRequest
BuyerReconfirmationRequest.description: Buyer response after seller remediation action.

buyer_name.title: Buyer Name
buyer_name.description: Optional: the one buyer this link is meant for.

is_serialized.title: Is Serialized
is_serialized.description: Whether listing requires serialized dispute/hold workflow.

unique_id.title: Unique Id
unique_id.description: Required unique identifier when is_serialized is true.

dispute_policy.title: Dispute Policy
dispute_policy.description: Policy metadata that constrains dispute resolution actions.

CreateListingRequest.title: CreateListingRequest
CreateListingRequest.description: Payload used by sellers to create listings.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Optional. The escrow amount is always the listing price; if sent, it must match the listing price exactly or the request is rejected.

CreateTransactionRequest.title: CreateTransactionRequest
CreateTransactionRequest.description: Buyer payload for creating a new escrow transaction.

DisputeCaseTimelineResponse.title: DisputeCaseTimelineResponse
DisputeCaseTimelineResponse.description: Full dispute timeline detail for admin triage and decision-making.

DisputeTimelineEventResponse.title: DisputeTimelineEventResponse
DisputeTimelineEventResponse.description: Single timeline event shown in admin dispute timeline views.

DoorRejection.title: DoorRejection
DoorRejection.description: Why the buyer rejected the item at the door.

EscalationQueueItemResponse.title: EscalationQueueItemResponse
EscalationQueueItemResponse.description: Admin queue item for escalated disputes awaiting review.

ListingListResponse.title: ListingListResponse
ListingListResponse.description: One page of the seller's own listings, newest first.

ListingPhotoResponse.title: ListingPhotoResponse
ListingPhotoResponse.description: A listing photo. `url` is relative to the API root.

status.title: Status

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: Ordered; the first is the cover.

ListingResponse.title: ListingResponse
ListingResponse.description: Listing representation returned by create/get listing endpoints.

ListingSellerSummary.title: ListingSellerSummary
ListingSellerSummary.description: What a buyer may see about the seller before paying.

ListingStatusCounts.title: ListingStatusCounts
ListingStatusCounts.description: How many of the seller's listings are in each status.

phone.title: Phone

LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse
LoginResponse.description: Authenticated user profile plus session expiry metadata.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: Whether the callback was accepted for processing and auditing.

duplicate.title: Duplicate

dedupe_key.title: Dedupe Key

provider_reference.title: Provider Reference

correlation_id.title: Correlation Id

NotificationResponse.title: NotificationResponse
NotificationResponse.description: Notification entry returned to the authenticated user feed.

OrderSegmentCounts.title: OrderSegmentCounts
OrderSegmentCounts.description: How many of the caller's orders are in each list segment.

otp_code.title: Otp Code
otp_code.description: Numeric OTP code shared at delivery handoff.

OtpGiveRequest.title: OtpGiveRequest
OtpGiveRequest.description: Buyer OTP payload for confirming delivery handoff.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: One of the listing's dispute_policy.door_reject_reasons, or other. Without declared reasons: damaged, wrong_item, not_as_described, missing_parts or other.

OtpWithholdRequest.title: OtpWithholdRequest
OtpWithholdRequest.description: Optional reason when the buyer rejects the item at the door.

result_code.title: Result Code
result_code.description: Provider result code (0 means successful payment).

PaymentCallbackRequest.title: PaymentCallbackRequest
PaymentCallbackRequest.description: Payment provider callback payload used to reconcile transaction payment state.

PaymentCallbackResponse.title: PaymentCallbackResponse
PaymentCallbackResponse.description: Outcome of callback processing and resulting transaction state.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: STK_PROMPT: a PIN prompt was sent to the buyer's phone. REDIRECT: send the buyer to redirect_url.

status.title: Status
status.description: expired: no answer before expires_at. Success is only final when the transaction status is locked.

failure_reason.title: Failure Reason
failure_reason.description: Why the prompt failed, when status is failed.

PaymentInstructionResponse.title: PaymentInstructionResponse
PaymentInstructionResponse.description: What the buyer was asked to do to pay, and how it went. Names no payment provider.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: Whether the callback was accepted for processing and auditing.

duplicate.title: Duplicate
duplicate.description: True when this callback was already processed for the dedupe key.

dedupe_key.title: Dedupe Key

provider_reference.title: Provider Reference
provider_reference.description: Order tracking id parsed from callback payload when present.

inquiry_outcome.description: Outcome from Pesapal status inquiry confirmation when available.

PesapalCollectionWebhookResponse.title: PesapalCollectionWebhookResponse
PesapalCollectionWebhookResponse.description: Acknowledgement payload for Pesapal collection callbacks.

phone.title: Phone

mpesa_phone.title: Mpesa Phone
mpesa_phone.description: Optional payout/charge phone for M-Pesa flows.

mpesa_account_name.title: Mpesa Account Name
mpesa_account_name.description: Optional account holder name associated with M-Pesa phone.

RegisterUserResponse.title: RegisterUserResponse
RegisterUserResponse.description: Registered user profile returned after account creation.

category.title: Category
category.description: Issue category (for example not_working, missing_parts, other).

description.title: Description
description.description: Detailed issue report supplied by the buyer.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Evidence metadata payload (links, notes, file references).

ReportFunctionalIssueRequest.title: ReportFunctionalIssueRequest
ReportFunctionalIssueRequest.description: Buyer dispute intake payload used during serialized hold window.

status.description: not_paid: the buyer hasn't paid. held: in escrow. in_progress: release queued or awaiting the provider. paid_out. delayed: the provider refused; retried or handled by support. refunded: the money went back to the buyer.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Released to the seller (gross), once releasing.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Provider reference of the succeeded release.

SellerPayoutResponse.title: SellerPayoutResponse
SellerPayoutResponse.description: Where the seller's money is for this order.

action.title: Action
action.description: Resolution action key, such as refund_issued or repair_shipped.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional seller notes for the selected action.

SellerResolutionActionRequest.title: SellerResolutionActionRequest
SellerResolutionActionRequest.description: Seller-selected resolution action in dispute flow.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: transaction_created or a notification event type, e.g. transaction_locked.

TimelineEventResponse.title: TimelineEventResponse
TimelineEventResponse.description: One step in an order's history, in plain words.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Random, non-sequential human-readable reference, for example VK-7K3P9Q.

custody_provider.title: Custody Provider
custody_provider.description: Who holds the money. 'econfirm' is real Tier-1 custody; 'simulated' is the Vekro-side simulated ledger and must never be presented as real money.

TransactionCreatedResponse.title: TransactionCreatedResponse
TransactionCreatedResponse.description: A new transaction and the payment prompt sent for it.

dispatch_by.title: Dispatch By
dispatch_by.description: locked: the seller must dispatch by then or the buyer is refunded.

inspect_by.title: Inspect By
inspect_by.description: at_door_pending_inspection: no decision by then withholds the code.

hold_until.title: Hold Until
hold_until.description: hold_24h: payment is released to the seller at this time.

return_send_by.title: Return Send By
return_send_by.description: disputed_functional: the buyer must send the item back by then.

return_confirm_by.title: Return Confirm By
return_confirm_by.description: return_in_transit: the seller must confirm receipt by then.

TransactionDeadlinesResponse.title: TransactionDeadlinesResponse
TransactionDeadlinesResponse.description: When the current state times out (UTC). Only the field for the current state is set.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Random, non-sequential human-readable reference, for example VK-7K3P9Q.

custody_provider.title: Custody Provider
custody_provider.description: Who holds the money. 'econfirm' is real Tier-1 custody; 'simulated' is the Vekro-side simulated ledger and must never be presented as real money.

viewer_role.description: How the caller relates to this transaction.

server_time.title: Server Time
server_time.description: Server clock when the response was built; offset countdowns with it.

door_rejection.description: Set when the buyer rejected the item at the door with a reason.

payment.description: The latest payment prompt. Shown to the buyer and admins only.

payout.description: The seller's payout. Shown to the seller and admins only.

TransactionDetailResponse.title: TransactionDetailResponse
TransactionDetailResponse.description: One transaction as its buyer, its seller or an admin sees it.

status_counts.title: Status Counts
status_counts.description: Per transaction status, before filters. Missing statuses are 0.

server_time.title: Server Time
server_time.description: Server clock; offset countdowns with it.

TransactionListResponse.description: One page of the caller's orders, with counts across all of them.

TransactionListingSummary.title: TransactionListingSummary
TransactionListingSummary.description: The listing the transaction was created from.

TransactionParty.title: TransactionParty
TransactionParty.description: A party to the transaction, safe to show to the other party.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Random, non-sequential human-readable reference, for example VK-7K3P9Q.

custody_provider.title: Custody Provider
custody_provider.description: Who holds the money. 'econfirm' is real Tier-1 custody; 'simulated' is the Vekro-side simulated ledger and must never be presented as real money.

TransactionResponse.title: TransactionResponse
TransactionResponse.description: Current transaction state and ownership metadata.

photo_url.title: Photo Url
photo_url.description: The listing's cover photo, when it has one.

counterpart.description: The other party: the buyer for a seller, the seller for a buyer.

TransactionSummaryResponse.title: TransactionSummaryResponse
